notes.subject: חבלי / נחלי
notes.rationale: khavlei/nachalei near-rhyme in the pair; the sound-echo is lost in Bambara

notes.subject: בליעל
notes.rationale: 'Belial' as proper name (JPS) vs 'worthless/ungodly ones' as common noun (KJV/ASV); kept as name with bracketed gloss

notes.subject: חבלי מות
notes.rationale: 'cords of death' (literal rope) vs traditional 'sorrows of death'; rope kept for the concrete image

translation: Saya kunw ye n lakolankyɛ, ani Belial (wɛrɛwilenw) ji-bonyaw y'o lasiran ni n ye.
